items.title: VW's First Car Made With Xpeng Isn't Popular. Here's Why It Matters
items.summary: The ID. Unyx 08 was supposed to help turn around Volkswagen in China. Instead, it struggles to move more than 250 units per month.
facts: Unyx 08 was supposed to help turn around Volkswagen in China.
Instead, it struggles to move more than 250 units per month.
Unyx 08 is only selling about 267 units per month.
This is well below its goal of 3,622 per month.
Unyx 08 is co-developed with Xpeng, and made at VW's Anhui plant.
Unyx 08, has been on sale since this April.
It is underperforming in China’s market, with only about 267 units sold per month through August, according to ThinkerCar data cited by Reuters.
According to internal company documents seen by Reuters, the automaker initially aimed to sell far more, about 3,622 units per month.
In 2019, the Volkswagen Group sold a record 4.2 million cars in China.

items.title: Ferrari's CEO Praises The Tesla Roadster: 'We Have To Keep Dreaming'
items.summary: Benedetto Vigna singles out the Roadster’s upside-down stunt, outside design help, and bold staging as a needed jolt for electric supercars.
facts: Benedetto Vigna singles out the Roadster’s upside-down stunt, outside design help, and bold staging as a needed jolt for electric supercars.
But that is exactly what Ferrari's CEO did this week, rating Tesla's redesigned Roadster a flat 10 out of 10, twice, for both its technology and its presentation.
Tesla Roadster Earns 10 Out Of 10

The car drove up a ramp and stayed attached while upside down using a powerful suction fan system, then launched off, turned in midair, and landed with help from compressed-gas thrusters derived from SpaceX hardware.
Coverage of the event framed the Roadster as a 2028 model and described that date as Tesla's target for bringing the car to market.

items.title: NHTSA proposes cyan lights for robotaxis, following Mercedes/China
items.summary: The NHTSA has proposed using cyan-colored lights to identify vehicles operating autonomously, along with other additions to get ready for autonomous vehicles. more…
facts: In a draft proposal released Friday, it suggested a whole new color for vehicle lamps, cyan, to signal autonomous operation.
The proposal was actually first put forward by Mercedes, alongside its DRIVE PILOT level 3 driver assist system.
This differs from systems like Tesla’s Full Self-Driving, which is actually only a “level 2” system, where the driver is still responsible when the system is on.

Unfortunately our demo was on a bright sunny day (a necessity to operate the level 3 system, which doesn’t run at night or in bad weather), so the lights didn’t pop as much as they might have in lower light, but you get the drift.

items.title: This Popular Car Accessory Has A Bigger Impact On MPG Than You Think
items.summary: There's one accessory often found of thousands of vehicles that can reduce your overall fuel economy.
facts: While those steps certainly help, other factors deserve equal attention, including a popular accessory sitting directly above your head that could be quietly costing you money in the long run.

Automakers spend millions of dollars fine-tuning vehicle aerodynamics, but practicality demands and aftermarket trends often compromise that work by significantly worsening a vehicle's drag coefficient.
We all know that crossbars and cargo boxes are undeniably useful for longer road trips, family vacations, and camping adventures.

items.title: Drivers didn’t start the culture war, but they may win it
items.summary: Proponents of public transport forget much of it is subsidised by motorists Are you engaged in a culture war? Perhaps you didn't realise; you just thought you were leaving work in time to collect a child for sports practice, before going to the shop on the way home and then maybe the cinema later. The problem is that you did that in a car, because there was no other convenient way. You thought you
facts: Perhaps you didn't realise; you just thought you were leaving work in time to collect a child for sports practice, before going to the shop on the way home and then maybe the cinema later.
You thought you were just one of the 42 million people in Britain with a driving licence driving one of the 34 million cars here and doing normal daily things.
Last year, two TikTokers bought a Citroën C1 and drove it from Stoke to London and back, saving £138 over taking the train.

Still, if you think taking a train is expensive, try not taking one: British taxpayers subsidise rail transport to the tune of £11.9bn every year, despite the fact it has 1.7 billion paying passengers.

In addition to four CCS charging points with up to 400 kW of charging power, Temse also features four megawatt charging points capable of delivering up to 1,500 kW.
facts: However, while the other three locations (Antwerp, Zwolle, and Landvetter) each offer only one MCS charger with up to 1.2 MW, the new Belgian charging park has four MCS chargers with up to 1.5 MW – making this a first for Milence at this scale.
In terms of pricing, charging rates in Belgium start at €0.379/kWh (excluding VAT) for ad-hoc charging (for both CCS and MCS).
Milence now has 39 charging hubs operational across Europe, with eleven more under construction.

items.title: Republic of Moldova presents national eMobility roadmap
items.summary: The Republic of Moldova has established a national eMobility programme which aims to expand the charging network to 600 public charging points by the end of the decade and electrifying 15 per cent of the vehicle fleet.
facts: The Republic of Moldova is a landlocked country covering around 33,846 square kilometres, with a population of nearly 3 million.
The government of this small republic has now published a document to advance electromobility in Moldova.
The number of public charging points is to increase from around 250 units (as of 2025) to at least 600 by 2030.
At least 30 per cent of the new charging stations are to be built outside the capital, Chișinău.
Additionally, the roadmap stipulates that by 2030, battery-electric vehicles and plug-in hybrids should account for at least 15 per cent of the national vehicle fleet.

items.title: Fraunhofer researchers aim to unlock the potential of lithium-metal anodes
items.summary: Researchers from two Fraunhofer Institutes are exploring new approaches to improving the performance and lifespan of battery systems. One idea is to use lithium itself as an active anode material in lithium-metal anodes, thereby achieving higher specific capacity in battery cells.
facts: The project has been running since September 2025 and is expected to continue until August 2028.

“On the one hand, a life cycle assessment (LCA) will be used to examine relevant material and energy flows as well as the environmental impacts of the approach; on the other hand, a concept for scaling the technology to larger pouch cells will be developed simultaneously,” the team explains.

items.title: 豊田章男会長、新型ミッドシップ4WD「GRヤリス風Mコンセプト」にモリゾウとして参戦 MTになったクルマに「左足を久しぶりに使うよろこびがある」
items.summary: 岡山国際サーキットでスーパー耐久第6戦が10月24日～25日の2日間にわたって開催されている。トヨタ自動車は、このS耐第6戦岡山にミッドシップ4WD開発車両である「GRヤリスMコンセプト」の改良版となる、「GRヤリス風Mコンセプト」のほかに、FRマシンである「GR86 Future FRコンセプト」を投入。このGR86 Future FRコンセプトでは、新たに新型2.0リッター直列4気筒自然吸気エンジンを搭載するなど、トヨタのさまざまな開発が見られるものになっている。
facts: 豊田章男会長、新型ミッドシップ4WD「GRヤリス風Mコンセプト」にモリゾウとして参戦 MTになったクルマに「左足を久しぶりに使うよろこびがある」
岡山国際サーキットでスーパー耐久第6戦が10月24日～25日の2日間にわたって開催されている。
トヨタ自動車は、このS耐第6戦岡山にミッドシップ4WD開発車両である「GRヤリスMコンセプト」の改良版となる、「GRヤリス風Mコンセプト」のほかに、FRマシンである「GR86 Future FRコンセプト」を投入。
このGR86 Future FRコンセプトでは、新たに新型2.0リッター直列4気筒自然吸気エンジンを搭載するなど、トヨタのさまざまな開発が見られるものになっている。
GRヤリス風Mコンセプトについては、外観上の変化も大きいが、このマシンがこれまでのスポーツ8速ATであるGR-DATから6速MTに変更されていることに言及。
2年間2ペダルATであるGR-DATの開発から、6速MTになったことで「左足を久しぶりに使うよろこびがある」という。
豊田章男会長は9月24日に米国自動車殿堂を受賞しているが、授章式のために渡米した際にテストコースで試作車両をドライブ。
そのためしばらく激しいことは避けていたようだが、このスーパー耐久第6戦岡山でドライバーとして復帰。
豊田章男会長は、「これは左ハンドルだろ、それもよかった。
ただ、その際にシフトミスが何度か発生したため、改めてシートとシフトレバーの位置を開発陣が確かめたところ、トヨタのノウハウが詰まった基準値よりも2mmずれていたとのこと。

items.title: An MX-5 for the family? 2000 miles in a manual Mazda 3
items.summary: Delightfully different or just outdated? We've lived with Mazda's humble hatchback to find out For a car maker whose line-up sits largely in the mainstream, Mazda has always ploughed a pleasingly unconventional furrow. It long resisted the push for electrification, instead developing its unusual compression-ignition technology to maximise the fuel economy of its Skyactiv petrol and diesel engines.
facts: Its first EV, the MX-30 , featured rear-hinged rear doors and cork trim (and a hopelessly small range); even Mazda's commitment to the MX-5 two-seater reflects a pushback against industry trends.
But its ICE models retain a pleasing dash of individuality – and that's why we have added the latest version of the 3 hatchback to our fleet.

While rivals such as the Peugeot 308 and Volkswagen Golf are offered with a range of powertrains including full and plug-in hybrids , the only electrified Mazda 3 comes in mild-hybrid form with a tiny battery and generator to aid economy – and in this case that small e-motor is bolted to a 2.5-litre e-Skyactiv G petrol engine.
Yes, a 2.5-litre engine.

items.title: This New Italian Sports Car Is The Closest Thing To A Modern Ferrari 308
items.summary: Its stunning styling is just the start. The Michelotto Gruppo 4 Tributo weighs less than 2,100 lbs, and it puts down nearly 400 hp from a 3.4-liter V8.
facts: This New Italian Sports Car Is The Closest Thing To A Modern Ferrari 308
Italian brand AC Motorsport has unveiled a modern take on the iconic Ferrari 308, created in partnership with local engineering and racing car firm Michelotto.
The car, badged the Michelotto Gruppo 4 Tributo, prioritizes a pure driving experience rather than earth-shattering performance like so many other new exotics.
The Gruppo 4 Tributo looks very much like a restomodded 308, but it's a new car built around a custom tubular chassis with lightweight composite panels.
We'd argue Ferrari designers have lost their way in recent years, giving us odd-looking supercars like the 849 Testarossa and F80.

items.title: GM is betting on battery cells that don’t use lithium [updated]
items.summary: GM has partnered with Peak Energy to develop next-generation sodium-ion battery cells, but they’re not going into EVs – they’re for grid-scale energy storage projects. GM Ventures is making a strategic investment in Peak Energy. more…
facts: June 10, 2026: Under the partnership, GM will develop the sodium-ion cells in its Michigan battery labs and retain exclusive manufacturing rights.
Peak Energy will integrate the cells into its battery storage systems as it ramps up US manufacturing.
According to the company, its sodium-ion platform can reduce energy storage costs by 20% compared with conventional systems while delivering more than 99% uptime.
It estimates that replacing conventional LFP storage systems with its passively cooled technology could reduce annual battery-storage energy waste in the US by up to 2 terawatt-hours.

items.title: Not Even A Partnership With Xpeng Can Save VW In China
items.summary: VW originally projected that they'd move nearly 4,000 a month, but the EVs they made in partnership with Xpeng aren't even close to meeting sales expectations.
facts: For years, China was Volkswagen's golden goose, serving as a crucial engine of growth that once accounted for almost 50% of the group's total profits.
Now, that figure has fallen to roughly 10%, and it doesn't even look like the brand's flashy partnership with Xpeng can save it.
It's been more than three years since VW joined forces with Xpeng, spending $700 million to acquire a 4.99% stake in the Chinese brand.
Unyx 08 and ID.
Unyx 08 averaged just 267 vehicles.
This represents less than 10% of VW's goal of selling up to 3,622 units each month.
What's more, VW initially forecast selling 32,600 during 2026, up to 70,400 in 2027, and more than 120,000 units annually in the future.

facts: The notice says regulators may require large infotainment screens, other displays, and HUDs to undergo assessments for driver safety, crash safety, and reliability in extreme conditions before they can be provided and sold.
These seats, which usually recline and have large leg rests, can't be used by a driver while the vehicle is moving, but nothing often stops a passenger from using them.

Hyundai IONIQ 5 vs IONIQ 9 lease comparison
Through September, the Hyundai IONIQ 5 was the third top-selling EV in the US, behind the Tesla Model Y and Model 3.
For one, it’s one of the most affordable EVs in the US, starting at about $35,000, and Hyundai has been offering some of the most attractive lease deals.

items.title: If You Have Some Spare Millions, You Could Buy A Legendary McLaren Formula 1 Car
items.summary: Several modern McLaren F1 cars are going up for sale, as well as a pair of MP4/6A models from the 1991 championship that were driven and tested by Ayrton Senna.
facts: If You Have Some Spare Millions, You Could Buy A Legendary McLaren Formula 1 Car
McLaren has built and raced some of the most successful Formula 1 cars ever and stores many of them at its famed UK headquarters.
Two highlights of the collection are a pair of McLaren MP4/6A models from the 1991 championship.
The first, chassis number 04, was raced by Gerhard Berger and finished second at the 1991 San Marino Grand Prix.
It was also tested extensively by Ayrton Senna and retains its original naturally aspirated Honda V12.
The second MP4/6A is chassis number 07 and was raced by Berger at four events, including the British Grand Prix and German Grand Prix.

items.title: Watch This BYD Hit The Three-Wheeled Motion To Avoid A Parking Boot

facts: A wild video circulating on Chinese social media shows the off-road-focused Fangchengbao Bao 8 doing its best impression of a '64 Impala lowrider by driving on just three wheel to avoid dealing with a parking boot.

The clip was filmed on a road in Jinshan Town, Lianyunggang, and it shows the dark green Bao 8 pulling out of a parking space with the left front wheel about a foot of the ground, rendering the boot useless.
That's because the Bao 8 features BYD's advanced DiSus-P Ultra suspension system.

The current generation debuted in 2021 and received a facelift in 2024, but Honda is keeping it fresh with another round of model year upgrades for 2027.
The exterior design of the 2027 Honda Vezel remains largely unchanged from the earlier mid-lifecycle update.

This dealer-installed kit includes a blacked-out grille with a different pattern, front and rear bumper extensions with black chrome inserts, black mirrors and rear spoiler, as well as a new set of 18-inch alloy wheels with a diamond-cut finish.
Inside the Vezel, there is a carry-over 7-inch digital instrument cluster and 9-inch infotainment display sticking out of the dashboard.

items.title: CPCA forecasts weak China NEV retail sales in October as peak season falters
items.summary: China's NEV retail sales are expected to come in at 1.07 million in October, down 16.5% year-on-year. For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
facts: - China's NEV retail sales are expected to come in at 1.07 million in October, down 16.5% year-on-year.
- Overall passenger car retail sales are forecast at 1.6 million, down 28.9% year-on-year.

China's retail sales of new energy vehicles (NEVs) are expected to total about 1.07 million in October, with penetration holding at an elevated 66.9% amid continued pressure on the broader auto market.
The forecast indicates that October NEV retail sales will decline by 16.5% year-on-year and by about 1.3% compared to September.
The penetration rate is expected to fall by 0.1 percentage points from September's record high of 67.0%.

items.title: China threatens retaliation if UK matches EU on tariffs
items.summary: EU's 'Made in Europe' benefits could be vital for UK manufacturers – but would require risky imposition of tariffs China has warned that it would retaliate with countermeasures if the UK follows the European Union and puts the brakes on imports of Chinese cars into the country. The issue has come to a head as the EU has reportedly given the UK an ultimatum to levy tariffs or face its cars being le
facts: “China urges Britain to abide by the rules of the WTO [World Trade Organisation] and think twice before acting before it follows the EU’s lead,” a spokesperson from the Chinese Ministry of Commerce said in a press conference on 19 October.

Separately, on 20 October, the UK business secretary Jonathan Reynolds told a government committee that a decision whether to impose tariffs remains “under close review” as discussions continue with the EU on the topic.

The speed at which Chinese brands including MG, Omoda-Jaecoo and BYD have established themselves in the UK has dramatically reshaped the UK market, with Chinese brands taking a 23% share in September .

items.title: Overhead wired charging comes to Austin electric bus fleet
items.summary: CapMetro’s Austin transit fleets electrified two public bus lines and opened two new park-and-ride facilities featuring overhead pantograph-style wired charging equipment to help Austinites breathe a little bit easier. more…
facts: Dubbed the Goodnight Ranch and Expo Center facilities debuted alongside the agency’s Rapid 800 and 837 electric bus routes, adding upgraded passenger amenities and end-of-line charging infrastructure to support its growing fleet of electric transit buses.
At CapMetro’s main bus depot, infrastructure partner Camber Charging supplied and installed two 1,440 kW charging systems connected to 48 industrial dispensers.
The installation provides 2.9 MW of total charging capacity, and is designed to support overnight charging for up to 48 electric buses simultaneously.

items.title: Canada freezes CO2 standards for passenger cars until 2029
items.summary: Canada's government is freezing fleet emission standards for passenger cars and light commercial vehicles at 2026 levels through 2029. This move aims to give automakers more flexibility. However, annual tightening of standards will resume starting with the 2030 model year.
facts: Canada freezes CO2 standards for passenger cars until 2029
The decision is part of a joint package of measures introduced by the Canadian federal government and the province of Ontario on 21 October.
Under the plan, the fleet-wide greenhouse gas emission limit will remain at 172 grams per mile, equivalent to approximately 107 grams per kilometre.
Annual tightening of the standards will resume only from the 2030 model year.
To achieve the target of 75 per cent electric vehicle sales by 2035, the fleet average must ultimately drop to 74 grams of CO₂ per mile, or about 46 grams per kilometre.
The governments justify the pause by citing the strained situation in the industry.

facts: The forthcoming Alpine 2+2 electric roadster will sit on the new platform developed for the next-generation A110 – but it will have a new look unrelated to that model, according to brand chief Philippe Krief.
The next-generation A110 EV will launch next year as the first model on the highly flexible Alpine Performance Platform (APP).
But while it will be an entirely new car, its styling it set to remain close to the previous A110, which takes inspiration from the 1960s original.
Alpine unveiled an A310 concept car (pictured below) at the Paris motor show, which was inspired by the company's 1970s coupé.

items.title: Bosch faces radical corporate restructuring amid competitive pressures
items.summary: The Bosch Group is undergoing an internal corporate restructuring. From August 1, 2027, the Mobility business sector will exist as an independent subsidiary, among others. Three additional areas will also be transferred to subsidiary companies. The group aims to enhance its competitiveness and operate with greater flexibility.
facts: Around 62,500 employees at Bosch in Germany are facing significant changes.
The company is undergoing a radical restructuring, transferring four divisions – previously under the umbrella of Robert Bosch GmbH – into independent, 100 per cent-owned subsidiaries.
Currently, more than 3,000 employees work in these areas.
The company justifies the structural restructuring within the group as a necessity to remain competitive: “We are operating in an increasingly challenging environment across our markets.

items.summary: The latest cuts bring the total planned job reductions to 5,500.
facts: Volvo Blames 'A Very Tough Environment' As It Cuts Another 2,500 Jobs
The latest cuts bring the total planned job reductions to 5,500.
Volvo is preparing to cut another 2,500 jobs worldwide, adding to the 3,000 layoffs previously announced.

About 2,000 affected positions will be in its home market of Sweden, with the remaining 500 elsewhere.

Primed to begin deliveries after summer, the new model will target “a large lower-priced market segment” than the EX60, which ranges from £57,000-£70,000. The new model is one of 13 new cars
facts: Volvo will launch a second electric car based on its new SPA3 platform in Europe next year, after the EX60 SUV.
Primed to begin deliveries after summer, the new model will target “a large lower-priced market segment” than the EX60, which ranges from £57,000-£70,000.

The new model is one of 13 new cars Volvo will launch globally by 2030 and will be designed and engineered primarily for the European market, in line with the company’s new regionalised product development strategy.
Volvo is also working on a new flagship SUV for the US, based on the XC90’s SPA2 platform, and six models specifically for China based on modular architecture from parent company Geely.

items.title: EU Auto Package: Committee votes to relax CO₂ rules
items.summary: In the European Parliament, standing committees have voted on the Auto Package. The votes are seen as an indicator of whether and to what extent the so-called combustion engine ban in the EU will be softened. The result: a majority of the Industry and Transport Committees are in favour of relaxing the CO2 rules, which the so-called centrist platform had internally agreed upon shortly before.
facts: A decision on the EU’s Auto Package is taking shape in the European Parliament, under which the de facto ban on new internal combustion engine vehicles in the EU from 2035 is set to be relaxed.

The first committee votes on Thursday, 22 October, are now the first tangible result of this internal majority-building, after the tug-of-war over the still-internal negotiating positions had frequently leaked.
Regarding the CO₂ fleet limits, this draft proposes that manufacturers must reduce the CO₂ emissions of their new cars by only 95 per cent instead of 100 per cent (compared to 2021) by 2035.

items.title: 入門的な使い方からもう1ランク上の使い方へ。接続法を変えると音も変わる！［外部パワーアンプで限界突破］
items.summary:
クルマの中で音楽を聴けるようにするための機器である「メインユニット」には普通、「パワーアンプ」が内蔵されている。しかしカーオーディオ愛好家の多くは敢えてそれは使わずに、「外部パワーアンプ」をシステムに組み込んでいる……。
◆基本は、「4chアンプ」の2ch分の出力でフロントスピーカーを鳴らす形。しかし…
というわけで当連載では、敢えて外部パワーアンプが使われている理由から外部パワーアンプの選び方、そして使い方までを解説している。前回はもっとも基本的な使い方について説明したが、今回はその1ランク上の使い方を紹介する。
まずは前回のおさらいをしておこう。もっとも基本的な外部パワーアンプの使い方とは、「4chパワーアンプ」を用意して、メインユニットの「外部音声出力（プリアウト）」を入力し（「外部音声出力」がなければスピーカー出力をハイレベルインプットに接続）、外部パワーアンプの2ch分の出力にて
facts: ◆基本は、「4chアンプ」の2ch分の出力でフロントスピーカーを鳴らす形。
前回はもっとも基本的な使い方について説明したが、今回はその1ランク上の使い方を紹介する。
もっとも基本的な外部パワーアンプの使い方とは、「4chパワーアンプ」を用意して、メインユニットの「外部音声出力（プリアウト）」を入力し（「外部音声出力」がなければスピーカー出力をハイレベルインプットに接続）、外部パワーアンプの2ch分の出力にてフロントスピーカーを鳴らす、というやり方だ。
で、その1ランク上の使い方とは「バイアンプ接続」だ。
これはつまり、パワーアンプの1chずつの出力をスピーカーユニットの1つ1つにあてがうという接続方法のことを指す。
こちらもパワーアンプの1chずつの出力を1つ1つのスピーカーユニットにあてがうというものだが、これとバイアンプ接続とは、「信号の帯域分割をする場所」が異なる。
例えば使われるスピーカーが2ウェイの場合、マルチアンプ接続では「ツイーター」へと送る信号と「ミッドウーファー」へと送る信号とに分割する作業を、パワーアンプの前段に置いた「プロセッサー」にて行う。
なおパッシブとは、市販スピーカーに付属している音声信号の帯域分割を行うメカだが、通常はパワーアンプの1ch分の出力のみを入力するようになっている。
しかしながらパッシブの中にはバイアンプ接続に対応しているものがあり、そしてそうであると入力端子が2つ存在することとなる。
つまりツイーター用の入力端子とミッドウーファー用の入力端子とを個別に装備しているので、それぞれにパワーアンプの1chずつの信号を入力できる。

items.title: 「まちタク埼玉西部」、坂戸市を中心に運用開始…タクシー8社が電脳交通の「DS配車アプリ」活用
items.summary:

坂戸市を中心とする埼玉県南西部交通圏では、買い物や通院、駅への移動など日常の移動手段としてタクシーが利用されている。一方、タクシー業界では乗務員不足や高齢
facts: 電脳交通は、国土交通省の2026年度「『交通空白』解消等リ・デザイン全面展開プロジェクト」地域交通DX推進タイプの補助対象事業として、坂戸市を中心とする埼玉県南西部交通圏で地域密着型タクシー配車アプリ「まちタク‐埼玉西部‐」の運用を開始した。

items.title: 2027 Subaru Outback Base Trim Returns, Lowering Price
items.summary: Subaru's 2027 Outback base trim drops the entry price to $34,540 delivered while keeping heated seats, all-wheel drive, and key safety tech.
facts: 2027 Subaru Outback Base Trim Returns, Lowering Price
Subaru's 2027 Outback base trim drops the entry price to $34,540 delivered while keeping heated seats, all-wheel drive, and key safety tech.
Subaru is charging less for the 2027 Outback than it did for the 2026 model, and the base trim still comes with a 12.1-inch touchscreen and standard all-wheel drive.
The new entry-level Outback starts at $32,995 with a $1,545 Destination & Delivery charge putting the sticker price at $34,540, according to Subaru of America.
That is $1,905 below where the 2026 lineup opened once destination is included.

facts: - The third-generation Qin Plus grows to 4,840 mm in length and will add roof-mounted LiDAR.
- The redesign comes as the Qin series faces sales pressure, with volume down 54.71% year-on-year in the first 9 months.
BYD's (HKEX: 1211) third-generation Qin Plus will officially launch on October 27, marking a redesign of the key family sedan as sales of the Qin series come under pressure.
The new model measures 4,840 mm in length, 1,900 mm in width and 1,498 mm in height, with a wheelbase of 2,800 mm.
Those dimensions are up 60 mm, 63 mm, 17 mm and 82 mm, respectively, from the current model.

items.summary: Aura concept hints at move away from crossovers for Jaecoo's premium-focused Lepas sibling Chery Group brand Lepas has shown off a sporty concept that indicates a potential shift away from the group’s near-total focus on SUVs. The Lepas Aura is a two-door shooting brake with chunky body volumes and a slimline cabin that previews a new design language for the newcomer brand. Lepas is a sister brand
facts: However, parent Chery has the same ambition for the brand that has already put the group’s combined market share ahead of Hyundai-Kia’s for September in the UK, including delivering the UK’s best-selling car in the Jaecoo 7.
Of the 739 cars Lepas sold in the UK in September, the majority were the L8 large plug-in hybrid SUV, with sales of the smaller L6 starting this month.
Lepas cars use the same T1X platform as other Chery Group model lines, including the Tiggo SUV models.
The car was shown at Chery Group’s week-long event at its HQ in Wuhu, China, where it also revealed the new Tiggo X7 and Omoda X SUVs, which take a more rugged and lifestyle-oriented approach.

items.title: Audi Q9 Debuts World-First Curved OLED Taillights
items.summary: Curved digital OLED panels on the Audi Q9 use 512 segments and ultra-thin glass to sharpen rear visibility and brake signal clarity.
facts: Audi Q9 Debuts World-First Curved OLED Taillights
Curved digital OLED panels on the Audi Q9 use 512 segments and ultra-thin glass to sharpen rear visibility and brake signal clarity.
The Q9 uses curved digital OLED taillights made from six glass panels just 0.1 millimeter thick that wrap around the rear quarter panels instead of sitting flat.
Audi calls the setup a world first and previewed it when the Q9 debuted this past July.
The hardware backs that up with 512 individually controllable lighting segments spread across those six panels.
Audi Q9 Curved OLED Taillights
Audi's curved digital Q9 flagship SUV changes that by shaping the glass substrate itself to match the rear quarter panel.

items.title: Toyota's Next Mid-Engined Coupe Is Going Racing This Weekend
items.summary: Here's another early glimpse of what will likely become the next MR2.
facts: Here's another early glimpse of what will likely become the next MR2.
Toyota introduced the GR Yaris M concept at the 2025 Tokyo Auto Salon, turning its rally-bred hot hatch into a test bed for a mid-engine layout.
The new images therefore offer a glimpse of how the project is evolving, not necessarily what the finished car will look like.

According to Japanese media, the coupe-bodied GR Yaris M concept is heading back to the racetrack this weekend, competing in the sixth round of Japan's Super Taikyu Series at Okayama International Circuit from October 23–25.
Toyota developed the GR Yaris M concept around its new G20E turbocharged 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine.

items.title: Nio third-gen ES8 reaches 160,000 deliveries, adding 10,000 in 33 days
items.summary: The third-generation ES8 remains a key sales driver for the Nio main brand more than 1 year after launch. For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
facts: - The third-generation ES8 remains a key sales driver for the Nio main brand more than 1 year after launch.
- ES8 deliveries totaled 10,546 in September, exceeding 10,000 for the third consecutive month.

Nio Inc's (NYSE: NIO) third-generation ES8 has reached 160,000 cumulative deliveries, with the large electric SUV remaining a key sales driver for the company's main brand more than 1 year after launch.
Nio announced on Friday that it delivered the 160,000th third-generation ES8 in Xi'an, Shaanxi province, in northwestern China, to a local couple who run a high-end equipment manufacturing business.
The owners chose the ES8 for its suitability for business hospitality and long-distance travel.

facts: The Atto 2’s interior has the big picture covered.
There’s a good-sized, split-level boot, whose capacity is rated at 50 litres greater in the Comfort than in the Boost, for reasons that BYD has yet to explain, but it is an ample size either way.

But there are also some dull, hard plastic mouldings and unconvincing material imitations in conspicuous places to mar the overall impression a little – and none of the more eccentric inclusions (guitar-string storage straps, anyone?) of the bigger Atto 3 to lift a pretty drab and unremarkable ambience.

items.title: Pony AI enters Central Asia with inDrive robotaxi pilot in Kazakhstan
items.summary: The partnership will use Kazakhstan as its initial pilot market, with robotaxis to be deployed first in the capital, Astana. For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
facts: - Pony AI will provide Gen-7 robotaxis and Level 4 autonomous driving technology, while inDrive will handle platform operations.
The 3 companies have signed a memorandum of understanding to explore the deployment of autonomous mobility services, with Kazakhstan as the initial pilot market, according to a statement on Friday.
Pony AI will supply seventh-generation (Gen-7) robotaxis and Level 4 autonomous driving technology, while inDrive will oversee platform operations and service management.
The partners will assess the technical, operational, regulatory and commercial feasibility of offering Level 4 autonomous ride-hailing services to passengers in Kazakhstan through the inDrive app.

items.title: Subaru Teases A New Manual WRX, But Only For Japan
items.summary: It's the first of three new cars coming with a clutch pedal.
facts: The Japanese automaker has teased a new version of its sports sedan equipped with the heavy-duty TY85 six-speed gearbox, confirming that the three-pedal WRX will join the regular production lineup in Japan next month.
The announcement matters because Japanese buyers have largely been limited to the WRX S4 with a continuously variable transmission (CVT).
Subaru recently offered the limited-production WRX STI Sport♯ with a six-speed manual, but only 600 examples were available, and buyers had to win the lottery first to earn the right to buy one.
It's reviving the more robust TY85 transmission previously used in the old WRX STI.

items.title: ブリヂストン、2輪車用タイヤ新商品「バトラックス アドベンチャー A42」発表会 アドベンチャーバイクにさらなる耐摩耗性とグリップ性能を与えるアップデート
items.summary: ブリヂストンは、アドベンチャーモデル向け二輪タイヤ「BATTLAX ADVENTURE A42」を2027年2月1日に発売する（グローバルでは2027年1月1日発売予定）。
facts: ブリヂストン、2輪車用タイヤ新商品「バトラックス アドベンチャー A42」発表会 アドベンチャーバイクにさらなる耐摩耗性とグリップ性能を与えるアップデート
ブリヂストンは、アドベンチャーモデル向け二輪タイヤ「BATTLAX ADVENTURE A42」を2027年2月1日に発売する（グローバルでは2027年1月1日発売予定）。
前作「A41」からオフロード向け派生モデルを経て、9年ぶりのアップデートとなる。
摩耗ライフは最大25％向上、ドライ・ウェットグリップもさらに改善
10月22日に、ブリヂストン グローバルMCタイヤ事業部長 坂上賢崇氏、MCタイヤ開発部 MCタイヤ設計第2課 四宮一輝氏が登壇する新商品発表会が開催され、アドベンチャーバイクは、欧州において2016年以降の10年間でタイヤ需要が45％上昇したとの調査結果もあるほど人気の高い二輪カテゴリであることが紹介された。
同社はそうした市場環境のなか、アドベンチャータイヤとしてオフロードに寄せた「AX41」や「AT41」というモデルも展開しているが、今回は2018年に発売したオンロードメインの従来モデルA41をアップデートしたものとなる。
具体的には、A42ではフロントとリアの両方で全面的に設計を見直し、新コンパウンド、新トレッドパターン、新構造を採用した。
加えて、トレッドパターンはA41と比べて全体的に短い溝を多数配したようなデザインに変更した。
こうした取り組みによって、A41比でフロントは18％、リアは25％と、それぞれさらなるロング（摩耗）ライフを達成した。

items.title: アルピーヌ初のEV『A290』11月19日発売へ 218ps・航続360km
items.summary:
アルピーヌ・ジャポンは、ブランド初の電気自動車（EV）となるホットハッチ『A290』を11月19日に発売すると発表した。

facts: - 2026年10月5日（現地時間） 発表
日産モータースポーツ＆カスタマイズ（NMC）は10月5日（現地時間）、オーストラリア・メルボルンのファーンツリー・ガリー日産に、海外で初となるNISMOパフォーマンスセンターを開設した。
本センターは、NMCと日産オセアニアが2026年5月に発表した、オーストラリアにおけるNISMOブランドの拡大に向けた計画を具体化するもの。
日産とNMCは、より多くの顧客にNISMOブランドとそのパフォーマンスに関する専門技術を届けるため、NISMOモデルのラインアップと展開市場を拡充し、ヘリテージサポート、レストア、パーツビジネスを強化していくとしている。
NMCの社長兼CEOであり、NISMOブランドのグローバルヘッドを務める真田裕氏は、「日本国外で初となるNISMOパフォーマンスセンターの開設は、私たちのグローバル展開における重要な節目です。
オーストラリアは海外初のNISMOパフォーマンスセンターの開設先としてふさわしい市場であるといい、パフォーマンスカーやGT-Rファンが集うコミュニティが高い存在感を示しており、オープニングイベントには、300人を超える日産・NISMOファンが参加した。
さらに、2026年5月に発表した計画に基づき、2027年以降、オーストラリア国内にNISMOパフォーマンスセンターを追加で開設する予定。

items.summary:
三菱ふそうトラック・バスは10月8日、大型トラックの『スーパーグレート』の電気回路（灯火器）に不具合があるとして、リコール（回収・無償修理）を国土交通省へ届け出た。
対象となるのは2023年8月25日～2025年4月17日の間に製作された21型式1車種、計2705台。
不具合の内容は、大型トラクタ等のけん引車両において、トレーラ用灯火器回路の設計検討が不十分なため、トレーラ側に不要な電流が流れることがある。そのため、ブレーキを踏んだ際にバックランプ回路にも電流が流れ、後退操作を行っていないのにもかかわらず、バックランプが点灯し、バックブザーが吹鳴するおそれがある。
改善措置として、全車両、不要なリレー回路を取り外す。
不具合の発生件数は16件、事故の報告は無い。

items.title: 最新のポルシェ「911カレラS」「タイカンGTS」、延べ1500kmで乗り比べ
items.summary: 日本に上陸したての「911 カレラS」を、一番乗りで試す機会に恵まれた。「慣らしも込みで！」というポルシェジャパンからのリクエスト付きだったが、腕も買われてと理解（誤解）して、喜んで引き受けた。途中、四国に寄り道をしながら、東京から3日間かけて延べ1500kmを走った。そしてこの相方として今回は「タイカンGTS」が選ばれた。
facts: 最新のポルシェ「911カレラS」「タイカンGTS」、延べ1500kmで乗り比べ
911のベストバイは「カレラS」？
日本に上陸したての「911 カレラS」を、一番乗りで試す機会に恵まれた。
途中、四国に寄り道をしながら、東京から3日間かけて延べ1500kmを走った。
筆者の自宅となる横浜を出て、150kWの急速充電が可能な第2東名高速道路の浜松サービスエリアで合流。
さていきなりだが筆者は、911のベストバイは「カレラS」だと常々思っている。
911 GT3のようなハードコアモデルの興奮を別にすれば、カレラSは911シリーズの中で、一番バランスが取れたモデルだ。
その原因の1つは、991型から採用しているフロントの20インチタイヤだろう。
カレラよりも10mm低いカレラSの車高を、さらに10mm下げたスポーツサスはストロークを規制し、おそらくレートも少し高い。
とはいえ速度域が低い日本では、カレラSでもフロント19/リア20インチサイズが適当ではないかと筆者は思う。
それでも走りの本質を問えば、やはり911はすばらしいスポーツカーだ。
別体のオイルタンクを持たないインテグレーテッドドライサンプとはいえ、水平対向6気筒エンジンは低く搭載されているのだろう。
“慣らし”を兼ねているからエンジン回転数は4000rpmに縛られてしまっていたが、常用域ではそれ以上まわす必要性がまったくない。
数字的には530Nmの最大トルクが2200rpmから発揮されるわけだが、実際2000rpmもまわっていれば、8速のギヤ比なら第二東名の上限である120km/hまで余裕でカバーできる。

items.title: スズキ『ジムニー』の丸目が進化!? 2027年以降、大幅改良でどう変わる
items.summary:
スズキの本格軽クロスカントリー車『ジムニー』に、2027年以降、大幅改良が実施される可能性が浮上した。伝統の丸型ヘッドライトと5スロットグリルを継承しながら、フロントマスクが刷新される可能性がある。
入手した情報によると、スズキは現行ジムニーの商品力をさらに高める改良を検討しているという。実現すれば、2025年11月4日に発売された通称「5型」に続く、「6型」に相当するモデルとなる。
◆現行ジムニーは6年以上が経過
現行ジムニーは、2018年7月に登場した4代目だ。ラダーフレーム構造や副変速機付きパートタイム4WD、前後3リンクリジッドアクスル式サスペンションなど、本格オフローダーとしての基本構造を継承。スクエアなボディに丸型ヘッドライトを組み合わせたデザインも人気を集めている。
これまで複数回の商品改良が実施されてきたが、外観の基本デザインは登場当初から大きく変わっていない。

facts: スズキの本格軽クロスカントリー車『ジムニー』に、2027年以降、大幅改良が実施される可能性が浮上した。
伝統の丸型ヘッドライトと5スロットグリルを継承しながら、フロントマスクが刷新される可能性がある。
実現すれば、2025年11月4日に発売された通称「5型」に続く、「6型」に相当するモデルとなる。
◆現行ジムニーは6年以上が経過
現行ジムニーは、2018年7月に登場した4代目だ。
ラダーフレーム構造や副変速機付きパートタイム4WD、前後3リンクリジッドアクスル式サスペンションなど、本格オフローダーとしての基本構造を継承。
スズキ ジムニー 現行直近の5型では、安全装備と運転支援機能が大幅に進化した。
4速AT車には全車速追従機能付きACCを採用し、後方誤発進抑制機能も追加した。
次の6型で注目されるのが、フロントマスクの刷新だろう。
今回の予想CGは、入手した情報をもとに6型の姿を描いたものだ。
フロントグリルは伝統の5スロット形状を踏襲しつつ、それぞれの開口部を大型化。
パワートレインは、現行の658cc直列3気筒DOHCターボ「R06A」型エンジンの継続が有力とみられる。
現行モデルの最高出力は64ps、最大トルクは96Nm。
トランスミッションは5速MTと4速ATを設定し、駆動方式には副変速機付きパートタイム4WDを採用する。
WLTCモード燃費は5速MT車が16.6km/L、4速AT車が14.3km/Lだ。
6型でも最高出力64psを維持しつつ、エンジン制御の最適化などによって、実用域での扱いやすさや燃費性能を高めるはず。

items.title: ダンロップ、天然ゴム農家支援を北スマトラへ拡大…第2フェーズで年間1740軒を目標
items.summary:
ダンロップ（DUNLOP）グループは、持続可能な天然ゴム調達に関する施策を初めて体系的に整理したと発表した。グループ横断の「持続可能な天然ゴム（SNR）部会」を核に、取り組みを加速する。
その一環として、インドネシアにおいて2026年4月から小規模天然ゴム農家支援プロジェクトの第2フェーズを実施している。本プロジェクトは、同グループの天然ゴム調達会社であるスミトモ ラバー シンガポール ピーティーイー エルティーディーが、天然ゴムの生産・流通を手掛けるハルシオン アグリ コーポレーション エルティーディーの天然ゴム加工会社ピーティー ホック トンと共同で2022年から進めているものだ。
第1フェーズでは生産性や農家収益の改善効果が確認された。第2フェーズでは、スマトラ島のジャンビ地域での継続支援に加え、新たに北スマトラのランタウプラパット地域へ支援を拡大する。両地域で年間約1740軒の農家

items.title: Smart #2 set for November 5 launch in China, retaining ForTwo's 2-seat layout
items.summary: The Couture Edition went on sale last week at an official retail price of 112,999 yuan ($16,820), with availability limited to 999 units in China. For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
facts: - The Couture Edition went on sale last week at an official retail price of 112,999 yuan ($16,820), with availability limited to 999 units in China.
- The all-electric ForTwo successor features a 2-seat layout and a 35.8-kWh battery that can charge from 10% to 80% in 20 minutes.
Smart, the joint venture between Mercedes-Benz and Geely Auto (HKEX: 0175), will launch the Smart #2 in China on November 5, advancing the roll-out of its all-electric 2-seat city car.
Smart China had previously announced that the #2 Premium variant would launch in early November, without specifying a date.
The Smart #2 succeeds the classic ForTwo 2-seat city car.

items.title: Another megawatt-level charger enters China: 300 miles in 5 minutes
items.summary: Chery has announced a 1.44 megawatt charging system, able to deliver 500km (311 miles) in 5 minutes. And it’s not even the fastest system available in China. more…
facts: Chery has announced a 1.44 megawatt charging system, able to deliver 500km (311 miles) in 5 minutes.
BYD has a 1.5MW charger which it has already installed 10,000 of, Geely just announced a 2.2MW charger, and CATL has a hyper-fast charging battery.
Chery announced a 1.44MW charger that can add 500km (311miles) of range to a battery in 5 minutes, and can charge from 10-97% in 6 minutes and 50 seconds, as reported by CarNewsChina.
Per CarNewsChina’s accounting, the new Chery “Volt-Dragon” battery is the second-fastest at reaching 97% state of charge, 23 seconds behind CATL’s 6 minute, 27 second record time.
FAW, Geely and BYD are all between 8 and 9 minutes for the same full charge metric.

items.title: 日野自動車、「第12回 バステク in 首都圏」出展へ…大型観光バス『セレガ』など展示へ
items.summary:
日野自動車は、10月30日（金）に海の森水上競技場（東京都江東区）にて開催される、バスの最新技術が集結する体験型イベント「第12回 バステク in 首都圏」に出展する。
本イベントでは、今年5月に発売した大型観光バス「日野セレガ」と、乗合バスの安全性向上に向けた「バス車内事故防止のための安全確認支援システム〈改良版〉」を紹介する。
■大型観光バス「日野セレガ」
国内トップレベルの安全装備と先進の運転支援機能を搭載し、ドライバーと乗客の双方に安心で快適な移動を提供するという。約20年ぶりにボディデザインを刷新しており、展示車両の見学が可能だ。

レンジローバー SV ULTRAは、2026年5月に発表した「レンジローバー」2027年モデルから導入した、レンジローバー史上最高峰のラグジュアリーと個性を追求したモデル。
さらに、DESIGNART TOKYO 2026では、東京を拠点とする建築事務所Klein Dytham architectureと共同で考案した、特別なデザイン・インスタレーション「響き」が披露される。
このインスタレーションは、レンジローバーのラグジュアリーとテクノロジーの頂点であるレンジローバー SV ULTRAを中心に据え、1970年の誕生以来、世代を超えて受け継がれてきたレンジローバーの世界観を表現。
公開の場となるDESIGNART TOKYOは、「INTO THE EMOTIONS ～感動の入口～」をコンセプトに、2017年にスタートしたデザイン＆アートフェスティバル。
2026年は、10月30日～11月8日に銀座、東京、六本木、外苑前、表参道、原宿、代官山、池尻エリアを中心に開催され、ジャガー・ランドローバー・ジャパンはスポンサーとしても参画する。

facts: It looked striking but lacked the V10 soundtrack that made the original so visceral.

The LFA uses the same chassis as the Toyota GR GT and GT3 race car, minus the twin-turbocharged hybrid V8.

items.title: スバル車の購入で寄付ができる「SUBARU Share the Love Event」日本初導入 2026年は11月19日～12月31日に実施
items.summary: スバルは10月21日、「一つのいのちプロジェクト」の一環として「SUBARU Share the Love Event」を日本で開始すると発表した。
facts: スバル車の購入で寄付ができる「SUBARU Share the Love Event」日本初導入 2026年は11月19日～12月31日に実施
まずは「いのち」「しぜん」「ペット」「えがお」の4つのテーマから開始
スバルは10月21日、「一つのいのちプロジェクト」の一環として「SUBARU Share the Love Event」を日本で開始すると発表した。
「一つのいのちプロジェクト」とは、航空機メーカーの歴史を持つスバルが「人を中心としたモノづくり」や「いのちを守る」というDNAを軸に、クルマづくりの枠を超えてユーザーや地域社会にとって大切なものを守り、思いやりのある社会を目指す社会貢献活動で、2023年に開始された。
新たに開始される「SUBARU Share the Love Event」は、日本国内の約440店舗のスバル販売店で、11月19日～12月31日の期間中にスバル車を成約した人に、大切にしたいテーマを選択してもらい、テーマに応じてスバルがパートナー団体へ1台あたり1万円の寄付を行なうことで、社会を支える活動につなげる取り組みとなる。

facts: 日野自動車と京王電鉄バスの「AIを活用したバス車内転倒事故防止システム」説明会 2027年の実用化を目指し検証開始
路線バスの自動運転化にはまだ高いハードルが存在する中、「まずは全国のバス事業者が今すぐ解決しなければならない現場の運行課題に応えることが最優先とし、約4年間にわたり京王バスと膝を突き合わせて開発してきました。
まず同社の事業規模として、京王電鉄バスグループ全体（2社合計）で車両約900両、従業員約2000名、年間輸送人員は約9000万人に達することを紹介。
国の施策としても、国土交通省の「事業用自動車総合安全プラン2030」にて世界最高水準の安全輸送を掲げていて、乗り合いバスの車内事故件数には「全国で年間85件以下」「関東圏で25件以下」という極めて厳格な削減目標が設定されていることを提示。
70代女性が後方座席へ移動中に発車してステップ付近から転倒・骨折した例や、80代女性が停車直前に手すりを放して転倒・入院となった例など、高齢者の骨折事故は後遺症やQOL（生活の質）低下に直結するため、非常に重大なリスクとしてとらえられていると言及した。
さらに、手すりやつり革につかまらない乗客も一定数存在し、1人の転倒事故でも運行停止やクレーム対応が発生するなど、ドライバーへの精神的プレッシャーは過大となっていると説明。
京王電鉄バスグループでは、入社1～5年目の毎年および3年ごとの集合教育やポスターなどでの啓発活動を徹底してきたものの、コロナ禍以降、業界全体の車内事故数は下げ止まり傾向にあるという。

facts: Ferrari’s first electric car, the Luce, will start at $560,800 in the US, with American deliveries planned for the second quarter of 2027.
That’s roughly $80,000 under the ~$640,000 number that has followed the Luce since its unveiling in May, including in our own coverage.
Where the $640,000 came from
Ferrari didn’t give a US price when it launched the Luce in Rome on May 25.
It gave a European one: €550,000.
Most outlets, us included, ran that through the exchange rate of the day, about $1.16 per euro, and got to roughly $640,000.
The problem is that European car prices are normally quoted with VAT included, and Italy’s rate is 22%.
Take the tax out and the Luce costs about €450,800 in Italy.

facts: New Jersey lawmakers are already looking to walk back one of the country’s most controversial e-bike laws, just months after the sweeping new regulations took effect and sparked widespread backlash from riders, bicycle shops, and advocacy groups.

A newly introduced bill, S4830, sponsored by State Senator Raj Mukherji, would remove licensing, registration, and insurance requirements for low-speed electric bicycles with motors rated at 750W or less and a maximum motor-powered speed of 20 mph (32 km/h).
This includes Class 1 and Class 2 electric bicycles.

items.title: Holger Scherr leaves Daimler Truck for SuperPanther
items.summary: Chinese e-truck manufacturer SuperPanther has appointed Dr. Holger Scherr to its European management team. Scherr will serve as Executive Vice President Europe, overseeing the establishment and expansion of the company's European operations. The appointment is a coup for SuperPanther, as Scherr joins the startup from Daimler Truck.
facts: According to his new employer, Scherr brings decades of leadership experience in the commercial vehicle industry, “including over 20 years […] at Daimler and Daimler Truck”.
In 2021, the manager took on the role of President and CEO of Beijing Foton Daimler Automotive Co Ltd and was most recently a member of the Executive Committee of Mercedes-Benz Trucks.
According to Scherr’s LinkedIn profile, his more than 20-year career at Daimler and Daimler Truck ended in April 2026.

items.title: We Jump Sand Dunes And Push The Chevy Silverado ZR2 To Its Limits | Review
items.summary: Roaring American power meets towering Tasmanian sand dunes. We put the 2026 Chevy Silverado ZR2 through its paces in the ultimate off-road test Down Under.
facts: We Jump Sand Dunes And Push The Chevy Silverado ZR2 To Its Limits | Review
So, when an invite landed in my inbox to spend a day driving the Chevrolet Silverado 1500 ZR2 in the sand, I jumped at the chance.

The Silverado 1500 ZR2 has been around for a few years now, offering a more aggressive edge to the popular Silverado and providing shoppers an alternative to the popular Ram 1500 RHO and the Ford F-150 Raptor.
The model we tested wasn't the recently updated 2027 model unveiled in the U.S.
As a place to test the off-roading abilities of a pickup like the Silverado ZR2, it's hard to think of a better location.

items.title: 経産省、EV補助金の上限を125万円から75万円に引き下げ 令和7年度補正CEV補助金の補助額を見直し

facts: 経産省、EV補助金の上限を125万円から75万円に引き下げ 令和7年度補正CEV補助金の補助額を見直し
2027年1月1日以降の新車新規登録車に適用。
軽EVは最大44万円、PHEVは最大48万円、FCVは最大87万円に
経済産業省は10月21日、令和7年度補正クリーンエネルギー自動車導入促進補助金（CEV補助金）の補助額を見直すと発表した。
予算が早期に終了する見込みとなったため、現行予算の範囲内で可能な限り長期間にわたり補助を継続することを目的としており、EV（電気自動車）の上限額を現行の125万円から75万円へ引き下げる。
見直し後の補助額は、2027年（令和9年）1月1日以降に新車として新規登録を受ける車両に対して適用される。
車両区分ごとの最高補助額（得点130以上）は、EVが従来の125万円から75万円、軽EVが従来の55万円から44万円、PHEVが従来の80万円から48万円、FCVが従来の145万円から87万円へとそれぞれ引き下げられる。
さらに、環境負荷の低減およびGX推進に向けた鋼材の導入に関する自動車メーカーの取り組みを評価して決定する加算額についても、従来の最大5万円から最大3万円（軽EVは最大3万円から最大1.8万円）へと見直される。
今回の見直しは、令和7年度補正予算CEV補助金の足下の申請状況を踏まえ、受付期間の最終期限である2027年2月12日よりも早期に予算が終了する見込みとなったことを受けたもの。

items.title: 【自動車研究家“山本シンヤ”が聞いた「MORIZOがニュル24時間へ挑む理由」】第24回：ニュルが生んだモリゾウとアストンマーティンのベッツCEOの奇跡の友情、奇跡のレース
items.summary: そしてこの2011年、もう1つの大きなハイライトとなったのが、英国の名門「アストンマーティン」との国境を超えた深い友情物語である。
facts: 自動車研究家“山本シンヤ”が聞いた「MORIZOがニュル24時間へ挑む理由」
第24回：ニュルが生んだモリゾウとアストンマーティンのベッツCEOの奇跡の友情、奇跡のレース
そしてこの2011年、もう1つの大きなハイライトとなったのが、英国の名門「アストンマーティン」との国境を超えた深い友情物語である。
両者の縁は、GAZOO Racingが中古のアルテッツァ2台で初めてニュルに乗り込んだ2007年にさかのぼる。
当時アストンマーティンを率いていたCEOのウルリッヒ・ベッツ博士は、自らステアリングを握って24時間レースに参戦する情熱的なカーガイだった。
「トップ自らがハンドルを握ってクルマの味を確かめる」
そして、トヨタとアストンマーティンの友情は、「シグネット」という1台の市販車によっても世界に証明された。
この2011年の24時間レース表彰式では、ADAC（ドイツ自動車連盟）から豊田章男社長とベッツCEOへ、モータースポーツの発展に貢献したとしてそろって「特別功労賞（モータースポーツ功労賞）」の盾が授与された。
この友情ドラマは、同年10月のニュル耐久シリーズ最終戦「VLN9」で、さらに劇的なクライマックスを迎える。
マシンはGRの「レクサスLFA」と、アストンマーティンの「V12ザガート」。
ステアリングを握るのはベッツCEO、チーフエンジニアのクリス・ポリット氏、飯田章選手、そしてモリゾウの4人。
10月15日、アイフェルの朝は気温1℃、路面温度1.5℃という極寒。

items.title: Kia’s EV6 GT beat out the Tesla Model Y and BYD Sealion 7 in a German EV comparison test
items.summary: Kia’s electric sports car beat out the Tesla Model Y Performance and BYD’s Sealion 7 in a recent comparison test by the German magazine Auto Motor und Sport , ranking first overall. more…
facts: Kia’s electric sports car beat out the Tesla Model Y Performance and BYD’s Sealion 7 in a recent comparison test by the German magazine Auto Motor und Sport, ranking first overall.
Kia EV6 GT takes first in German performance EV test
Kia’s electric sports car, the EV6 GT, took first place in a recent high-performance EV test in Germany, the heart of Europe.

The comparison test, held by German auto magazine Auto Motor und Sport, evaluated five high-performance EVs across seven categories: body, safety, comfort and convenience, powertrain, driving performance, environmental friendliness, and running costs.

items.title: London considers mandating BEVs for new ride-hailing licences
items.summary: Transport for London (TfL) has launched a consultation on stricter licensing rules for ride-hailing services, such as Uber. TfL is considering requiring all newly licensed vehicles to be fully electric from 2028. Wheelchair-accessible vehicles would have a transition period until July 2030.
facts: Under proposals that now open to public consultation, only fully battery-electric vehicles would be eligible for new private hire vehicle licences starting in 2028.
The proposed regulation would apply to vehicles dispatched via ride-hailing apps such as Bolt, Lyft and Uber, as well as traditional minicabs, but not to separately regulated taxis.
For wheelchair-accessible vehicles, the requirement would take effect from July 2030.
The consultation runs until 2 December 2026.
According to the authority’s forecasts, nitrogen oxide emissions from the PHV fleet could decrease by nine per cent and CO₂ emissions by 35 per cent within the first ten years.

items.title: BYD Fang Cheng Bao sets launch windows for Tai 9 and Shark pickup in China
items.summary: The Tai 9 will officially launch after November 15, while the Shark pickup is scheduled to launch in China in late November or early December. For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
facts: - The Tai 9 will officially launch after November 15, while the Shark pickup is scheduled to launch in China in late November or early December.

BYD's (HKEX: 1211) Fang Cheng Bao has outlined launch plans for 2 new models, with the Tai 9 full-size SUV set to roll out first, followed by the Shark pickup's introduction to China.
Xiong Tianbo, general manager of Fang Cheng Bao, said on Weibo on Thursday that the Tai 9 will officially launch after November 15.
Display and test-drive vehicles will begin arriving at dealerships in late October.

items.title: Fortescue is using KUKA welding robots to handle 6 MW charging cables [video]
items.summary: Humanoid robots aren’t ready to juice up the massive, 240-tonne electric haul trucks Fortescue is putting to work in Australia’s punishing Pilbara. Instead, the company is using specially modified and massively powerful automotive assembly-line robots from KUKA to wrangle the massive cables needed to deliver a mind-bending 6 MW of power to its trucks’ batteries. more…
facts: Humanoid robots aren’t ready to juice up the massive, 240-tonne electric haul trucks Fortescue is putting to work in Australia’s punishing Pilbara.

Instead, the company is using specially modified and massively powerful automotive assembly-line robots from KUKA to wrangle the massive cables needed to deliver a mind-bending 6 MW of power to its trucks’ batteries.

While Chinese car brands capable of 2 MW “flash charging” are making headlines these days, Fortescue and Liebherr have been quietly working together to develop a 6MW charging system for their massive, ultra heavy-duty mining rigs since 2024 – but details about how the process actually works have been scarce.

items.title: Electrify America opens its largest EV charging station to date
items.summary: The new charging site has opened in Orlando, Florida, and features 24 DC fast chargers capable of delivering up to 350 kW each. It's located at the Sand Lake Corners South shopping centre and serves both local drivers and visitors travelling to nearby attractions, including Disney World and Universal Studios.
facts: Each of the 24 chargers are equipped with CCS connectors, with the location also providing access to Interstate 4 and Orlando International Airport as well as nearby dining and shopping options.
Electrify America already operates more than 350 chargers at over 60 sites across Florida, where the company says had the second highest number of registered EVs in the US in 2025 after California.
A further 10-charger site is also set to open in Orlando in the coming months.
In June, the company opened a 20-bay station in Santa Barbara, CA, equipped with chargers rated at up to 350 kW and a 1.9 MW battery energy storage system.

facts: Tesla has lowered its 2026 capital spending forecast.
In its Q3 10-Q, the company now says it expects capital expenditures “to be in excess of $20 billion in 2026,” down from the “more than $25 billion” it had guided since April.
The change was in the 10-Q Tesla filed Wednesday, not in the shareholder letter it released the same day.
And it lands in a quarter where Tesla reported $1.53 billion of positive free cash flow, a number that depends a lot on timing.
Tesla’s 2026 capex guidance keeps moving
Tesla started 2026 guiding to about $20 billion in capex.

items.title: Rivian Follows Tesla And Will Use Owners To Beta Test Autonomous Driving
items.summary: Who knew owning a Rivian could open up an unpaid engineering internship? That's basically what this beta test of Rivian's self-driving system equates to.
facts: Well, it seems Rivian is taking a page out of Tesla's playbook and is going to start allowing select owners to beta-test its most advanced Level 2 driver assistance system, known as Point to Point.
The invite-only Autonomous Early Access Program is available for second-generation R1 and R2 owners currently subscribed to the Autonomy+ system.
They will also need to participate in monthly surveys and may be required to join focus groups and one-on-one interviews.
To ensure selected owners continue to use the system wisely, Rivian will re-check eligibility every 30 days and can remove participants if they don't meet their obligations or drive safely enough.

items.title: Chery Tiggo X7 set for UK as rugged new flagship
items.summary: New X model range draws on the look of boxy 4x4s as Chinese brand targets new, leisure-focused buyers The Chery Tiggo X7 is the first in a line of more rugged models to come from the Chinese brand – and, Autocar understands, it will be sold in the UK. Although Chery has yet to officially confirm any plans for the new model, its UK MD Farrell Hsu recently told Autocar that it will offer the new X r
facts: The Chery Tiggo X7 is the first in a line of more rugged models to come from the Chinese brand – and, Autocar understands, it will be sold in the UK.
To that end, the Tiggo X7 has a much boxier look than the other Cherys sold in the UK, being reminiscent of long-established 4x4s such as the Land Rover Defender and Toyota Land Cruiser.
Chery has also yet to confirm whether it will follow the same naming template in the UK as China: BMW already sells the X7 luxury SUV here, alongside the X1, X2, X3, X4, X5 and X6.

items.title: India: Switch Mobility starts fulfilling 50-unit intercity electric bus order
items.summary: Switch Mobility has delivered six intercity electric buses to Purple Bus, the operating brand of Pune (Maharashtra)-based Indian private bus operator Prasanna Purple Mobility Solutions. These buses form the first batch of a 50-unit order the company announced in August.
facts: India: Switch Mobility starts fulfilling 50-unit intercity electric bus order

Purple Bus is using the newly inducted intercity electric buses on a new route connecting Nagpur and Chandrapur, two cities located approximately 150 kilometres apart in the Vidarbha region of Maharashtra.

The 50 intercity electric buses Purple Bus is acquiring from Switch Mobility are all EiV12s, a 12-metre model which is available not only in intercity but also in low-floor, tarmac, and staff versions.
The intercity version features pushback seats and accommodates up to 45 passengers.
The company claims the EiV12 intercity coach can travel 350 kilometres on a single charge.

items.title: CATL expands battery swap partnership as BAIC plans adoption across multiple brands
items.summary: BAIC will connect models across multiple brands to CATL's battery swap network and open its dealer network to support station construction. For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
facts: - The companies aim to build a battery swap ecosystem serving vehicles in the million level.

Beijing Automotive Group, or BAIC Group, has reached an agreement with CATL (HKEX: 3750) to deepen their battery swap partnership, expanding the range of compatible models and using its dealer network to support station construction.
BAIC will also open its dealer network to support CATL's deployment of swap stations around dealerships.
Their goal is to build China's first mature battery swap ecosystem serving vehicles in the million level, BAIC said.
In June 2024, BAIC and CATL signed a deal covering swap-compatible vehicles, battery block development and battery data management.

items.title: Greater range at the same weight: silicon battery passes laboratory test
items.summary: A critical breakthrough in battery research saw film cells with silicon-rich anodes endure over 1,000 cycles in testing without dropping below 80 per cent capacity. We explore the parameters that play a key role and what this progress could mean for electric vehicles.
facts: Researchers at the Fraunhofer Institute for Solar Energy Systems (ISE) have successfully operated a self-manufactured 25-Ah pouch cell with silicon-rich anodes for over 1,000 full cycles as part of the ‘StrOboBatt’ project.
After testing, the cell retained more than 83 per cent of its capacity.
This achievement marks an important milestone in battery development: 1,000 full cycles with at least 80 per cent capacity retention are considered the minimum requirement for commercial use.

items.title: The 2027 Ford Mustang Mach-E Has More Range As Standard
items.summary: The extended-range battery is now fitted at no extra cost across the lineup. Plus, there’s a new Trail trim with lifted suspension.
facts: The 2027 Ford Mustang Mach-E Has More Range As Standard
- A larger battery is now standard on the 2027 model, leading to more range on the base models.
The 2027 Ford Mustang Mach-E is here, and it comes with a few meaningful updates over the outgoing model.

The 73-kilowatt-hour battery that used to be installed on the Select and Premium trims as standard has been removed from the lineup, leaving the 88-kilowatt-hour pack as the only option for these two trims.
Meanwhile, the Mach-E GT and Rally get a 91-kilowatt-hour battery, just like before.
2027 Ford Mustang Mach-E Trail

items.title: Ford's Electric Mustang Gets Cheaper And More Rugged For 2027
items.summary: Every Mustang Mach-E also gets standard longer-range batteries for the new year, too.
facts: Ford's Electric Mustang Gets Cheaper And More Rugged For 2027
Ford has reworked the entire Mach-E lineup for 2027.
The base Select RWD now starts at $42,460 with destination and delivery fees included, a $600 discount compared to 2026.
Order banks for the refreshed electric crossover open October 22, 2026.
A new off-road Trail package joins the range for the Select eAWD, with Rally shipments expected to start arriving in the first quarter of 2027.
What's New For 2027
2027 Ford Mustang Mach-E Trail
Every 2027 Mach-E now comes with an extended-range battery as standard equipment.
Select and Premium trims carry 88.0 kilowatt-hours of usable capacity, while GT and Rally step up to 91.0 kilowatt-hours.

items.title: Honda Is Finally Bringing Race-Inspired Parts To Its Road Cars
items.summary: An exhaust upgrade for the Honda Passport adds 1.9 inches of ground clearance.
facts: An exhaust upgrade for the Honda Passport adds 1.9 inches of ground clearance.
Honda Racing Corporation's 19-Inch Wheels
One of HRC’s first retail products is a set of 19-inch wheels for the Honda Civic Type R and Acura Integra Type S.
HRC developed them in partnership with 2elle engineering, the wheel supplier for the Acura ARX-06.
The wheels measure 10 inches wide, 0.5 inches wider than stock, and weigh 20.8 pounds, or 5.5 lbs less than OEM.
The wheels also have a 55-millimeter offset, 5 mm more than stock.
They fit 2023 and newer Civic Type Rs and 2024 and newer Integra Type Ss.

items.title: The 2027 Ford Mustang Mach-E gains a standard long-range battery and starts at $40,000
items.summary: Ford opened orders for the 2027 Mustang Mach-E , which now offers a standard extended-range battery for under $40,000. A new Trail model is also joining the lineup. more…
facts: Ford opened orders for the 2027 Mustang Mach-E, which now offers a standard extended-range battery for under $40,000.
2027 Ford Mustang Mach-E prices and range
The 2027 Mustang Mach-E drops the standard-range battery offered in the 2026 model and now comes standard with the larger 88 kWh battery.
The 2027 Ford Mustang Mach-e is available in five trims: Select, Premium, GT, Rally, and a new purpose-built Trail model.
The new 2027 Ford Mustang Mach-E Trail is available for a $2,295 package upgrade for the Select eAWD.

items.title: China's Ford Ranger Rival Looks Tough With Ironman 4x4 Accessories
items.summary: Coming to the Australian market in 2027, this Chinese pickup truck rival to the Ford Ranger recently unveiled a partnership with off-road outfitter Ironman 4x4.
facts: China's Ford Ranger Rival Looks Tough With Ironman 4x4 Accessories
The Chery Stockman is coming soon to Australia
Chery's plug-in diesel Stockman pickup made headlines earlier this year with rugged looks and 469 horsepower.

Now, the company is back with a comprehensive lineup of factory-backed accessories developed by Australian tuner Ironman 4x4, amplifying the appeal of the Stockman to local buyers prior to its market launch.
They are also compatible with the Stockman's ADAS sensors and have been crash tested.
This serves as the mounting point for auxiliary lights, LED foglights, a 12,000-pound winch cradle, dual recovery points, and a heavy-duty skid plate.

items.title: BMW’s Electric M3 Had To First Win Over One Of Its Own
items.summary: Winning over a skeptical test driver takes more than horsepower.
facts: BMW’s Electric M3 Had To First Win Over One Of Its Own
- The electric BMW M3 impressed its Nürburgring test driver with its confidence and precision.
- The M3 EV will sit above the i3 M60, with four motors and a stronger focus on track performance.
- BMW will offer both electric and gas-powered M3s, giving buyers a choice.
BMW knows some enthusiasts will need convincing that an electric M3 deserves the M badge.
In its latest M3 EV development documentary, BMW singles out one particularly demanding audience: the man who drives its M cars on Nürburgring record runs.
Jörg Weidinger, a racing driver and BMW M development engineer, helps determine how these cars behave when pushed.

items.title: Nvidia embraces European automakers
items.summary: Nvidia is expanding its business with technologies for automated driving in Europe. For example, the ridesharing service Bolt is relying on the Alpamayo stack from the AI company for its planned robotaxis, and VWN is showcasing the ID. Buzz AD with Nvidia Hyperion. At the same time, Volkswagen, Porsche, and other partners are advancing a joint data and simulation platform.
facts: At its ‘GTC’ AI conference in Berlin, the world’s most valuable company presented several partnerships and new technologies spanning driver assistance systems, robotaxis and autonomous commercial vehicles.
Under the partnership, at least 25,000 Level 4-capable Lucid vehicles are to be deployed on European markets.
Bolt aims to operate a total of 100,000 autonomous vehicles on its platform by 2035.
Mercedes-Benz, for its part, is expanding its cooperation with Nvidia on Hyperion and Alpamayo to further develop its capabilities for Level 3 and 4 automated driving.
However, this is ‘only’ a driver assistance system, not a driverless Level 4 robotaxi.

items.title: GM announces new efficient EV platform
items.summary: GM has streamlined its development processes and introduced a new platform in a shorter timeframe, with the first production vehicles set to debut "very soon". From 2028, vehicles on the platform will also feature significantly more efficient batteries and a faster, centralised computing system.
facts: Reuss emphasised during the presentation that GM, as a global corporation, stands to benefit from the worldwide rise in EV sales.
There, a pickup named ‘Fathom’ is set to be the first model to enter production at the end of next year, priced at around US$30,000.
According to GM, this has resulted in an EV base that reduces vehicle weight by 15 per cent, improves aerodynamics by 25 per cent, and cuts powertrain components by 40 per cent.
According to the manufacturer, this increases the overall range by 20 per cent per kilowatt-hour.
Using digital simulations, the developers tested over 300,000 battery designs before building the first physical prototype.

items.title: Toyota Land Cruiser Recall Covers 105,000 SUVs Over Fuel-Leak Fire Risk
items.summary: Hybrid versions of the J250-generation Toyota Land Cruiser face inspection or fuel-tube replacement after reports of leaks and warranty claims.
facts: Toyota Land Cruiser Recall Covers 105,000 SUVs Over Fuel-Leak Fire Risk
Hybrid versions of the J250-generation Toyota Land Cruiser face inspection or fuel-tube replacement after reports of leaks and warranty claims.
Toyota is recalling 105,794 Land Cruiser Hybrid SUVs from the 2024 through 2026 model years over a fuel-tube connection that can come loose near the tank.
Owners of the current J250-generation Land Cruiser are affected across three model years.
Toyota has logged 23 field reports and 64 warranty claims tied to the problem so far.
Recall Covers 105,794 SUVs
2025 Toyota Land Cruiser
The recall covers model year 2024 through 2026 Land Cruiser Hybrids, totaling 105,794 vehicles.

パワートレインは、最高出力150kW（204ps）・最大トルク340Nmを発生する2.0ℓ直列4気筒直噴TFSIエンジンに、48VマイルドハイブリッドシステムのMHEV plusを組み合わせている。
電気モーターのPTG（powertrain generator）が、減速時に最大25kWのエネルギーを回収するとともに、加速時には最大18kWの駆動力でエンジンをアシストし、一定の条件下ではエンジンを使わない走行も可能で、快適で効率性に優れた走行を実現する。
トランスミッションには7速Sトロニックを採用し、素早く快適なシフト操作とさらなる高効率を達成した。

items.title: CATL’s Akin Li: “Whichever battery type the market demands, we’ll have it”
items.summary: CATL is a near-indispensable supplier to the emerging European e-truck industry, with many model series from local manufacturers running on cells or entire battery packs from the Chinese company. We met with CATL’s top manager Akin Li to explore how CATL plans to further strengthen its partnerships with Europe’s truck manufacturers.
facts: With this in mind, we spoke with CATL’s top executive for international business about the company’s localisation plans for Europe as well as the fundamental debate between NMC and LFP.
CATL manufactures battery cells based on both NMC and LFP chemistries.
We produce NMC cells, and we also have LFP and even sodium-ion batteries.
To be honest, we don’t know which chemistry will be the best around the year 2035.

What we can say is this: no matter which one turns out to be the best – CATL will have it ready; whether it’s NMC, LFP, sodium-ion, entirely different chemistries, or solid-state – even if the latter is still a long way off.

items.title: Redwood and Rivian set to expand their EV battery recycling partnership
items.summary: Redwood Materials and Rivian are expanding their existing EV battery partnership, adding a fresh battery material recycling effort to the EV startup’s Normal, Illinois, vehicle factory and, potentially, other Rivian-owned sites. more…
facts: Enough sense, anyway, that Rivian decided to put the idea to work as it built out its R2 production line at the former Diamond-Star Mitsubishi plant in Normal.
Back in April, the upstart EV brand signed on for 10 MWh worth of energy storage using repurposed Rivian battery packs – but that deal was just the beginning.

What’s more, the new deal will see retired Rivian batteries put to use in other stationary energy projects before eventually recycling some 99% of those batteries’ critical materials (nickel, cobalt, copper, and lithium).
With the recent launch of what is sure to be the more popular, more affordable R2, that’s suddenly a much bigger deal than it might have been last year.

items.title: 【三菱 eKクロスEV 新型試乗】デザイン刷新！ 台頭するライバルに勝る魅力はあるのか？
items.summary:
三菱eKクロスEV P（FWD）【試乗記】
三菱の軽乗用電気自動車（EV）「eKクロスEV」が、一部改良でデザインを刷新！ 2022年発売の古参の一台は、台頭するライバルをどう迎え撃つのか？ 最新モデルと比べても、キラリと光る魅力はあるのか？ 軽EVのパイオニアが擁する一台の実力を確かめた。
急速に充実した軽EVのラインナップ
2009年に「三菱i-MiEV」がデビューしてから十数年、ここにきて、いよいよ軽乗用EV市場が群雄割拠の様相を呈してきた。
【画像】三菱eKクロスEV P（FWD）【試乗記】 の詳細画像をもっとみる
2026年7月には中国からの黒船こと「BYDラッコ」が日本に上陸。さらに2026年10月には、軽自動車ナンバーワンのスズキもついに「eスカイ」で市場へ参入。これにより、ダイハツを除いて自前で軽自動車の開発・製造を行っているすべてのメーカーが、軽乗用EVの販売を開始した。
facts: 2022年発売の古参の一台は、台頭するライバルをどう迎え撃つのか？
2009年に「三菱i-MiEV」がデビューしてから十数年、ここにきて、いよいよ軽乗用EV市場が群雄割拠の様相を呈してきた。
2026年7月には中国からの黒船こと「BYDラッコ」が日本に上陸。
さらに2026年10月には、軽自動車ナンバーワンのスズキもついに「eスカイ」で市場へ参入。
デビューから4年を経て行われた一部改良の最大のトピックは、デザインの刷新だ。
2022年5月に発表されて以来、初めて外観に手が加えられたのである。
これまでのeKクロスEVは、クロスオーバーを表す「クロス」という車名のとおり、「デリカD：5」をほうふつさせるフロントまわりをはじめ、SUVテイストを前面に押し出したデザインが大きな特徴になっていた。
内装では、AC100V・最大1500Wのアクセサリーコンセントをインパネ下部に新設するなど、利便性の向上を中心とした改良を実施した。
ちなみに、衝突軽減ブレーキなどの運転支援装置において、3つのグレードで差をつけていないのは、良心的な対応といえるだろう。
軽自動車の自主規制枠の上限にあたる64PSの最高出力と、2リッター自然吸気エンジン並みの195N・mの最大トルクを発生するモーターや、WLTCモードで一充電あたり180kmの走行を可能にする容量20kWhのリチウムイオン電池など、パワートレイン系に大きな変更はない。
eKクロスEVに乗るのは、4年前の発売当初以来のこととなる。

items.title: BEV registrations rose sharply across Europe in September
items.summary: Registrations of electric cars in the EU rose sharply in September. According to ACEA, 290,117 pure electric cars were newly registered - 72.9 per cent more than in the same month last year. This put their market share at 29.9 per cent in September. Since the beginning of the year, BEVs have achieved a market share of 22.7 per cent.
facts: According to the manufacturers’ association ACEA, 290,117 new battery-electric passenger cars were registered in the EU in September.
This represents an increase of 72.9 per cent compared to the same month last year.
Across all powertrain types, 971,048 new passenger cars were registered in September, 9.3 per cent more than in September 2025.
The share of pure electric cars thus reached 29.9 per cent in September, meaning almost three out of ten newly registered passenger cars had a fully electric powertrain.
From January to September, 1,931,465 new electric cars were registered in the EU, an increase of 48.5 per cent compared to the same period last year.

items.title: Dubai Police Issue 7,735 Fines For Loud Exhausts And Illegal Mods
items.summary: Dubai Police separated 2,045 noise violations from 5,690 illegal modification cases, each carrying fines, black points, and possible vehicle impoundment.
facts: Dubai Police Issue 7,735 Fines For Loud Exhausts And Illegal Mods
Dubai Police separated 2,045 noise violations from 5,690 illegal modification cases, each carrying fines, black points, and possible vehicle impoundment.
Dubai Police issued 7,735 traffic fines during the first nine months of 2026 for excessive vehicle noise and unauthorized engine or chassis modifications.
The force also impounded 1,630 vehicles tied to those same violations.
Excessive noise accounted for 2,045 violations and 333 impounded vehicles, according to Dubai Police.
Unauthorized engine or chassis modifications made up the larger share of the enforcement total, with 5,690 violations and 1,297 vehicles pulled off the road.

items.title: Tesla Q3 results: full order books, but declining figures
items.summary: Tesla's revenue is stagnating, with the US electric car manufacturer witnessing a significant drop in profits during the third quarter. However, the Americans' car business is not doing poorly - order books are full. The reasons lie elsewhere.
facts: Tesla Q3 results: full order books, but declining figures
Revenue from the automotive division fell by three per cent year-over-year between July and September – to $20.56 billion.
Only through ancillary business areas has Tesla managed to match last year’s total revenue ($28 billion).
Tesla also roughly achieved the $28 billion revenue mark in the second quarter of this year.
However, it is notable that in Q3 2025 and Q2 2026, Tesla reported billion-dollar profits at similar revenue levels.
This is no longer the case: GAAP net income plummeted to $787 million in the last quarter – a massive decline of 43 per cent compared to the same quarter last year.

検討項目の1つである「車両の相互補完」において、各社がグローバルで持つ四輪商品を相互に活用し、事業環境や地域ごとのニーズに応じた商品ラインアップの拡充に向けて協議を重ねてきた。
今後も3社が有する商品・技術アセットを活用し、戦略的パートナーシップ深化の取り組みを進めるとしている。

facts: カワサキ、新型「ニンジャH2カーボン」を2027年1月23日発売 価格418万円
カワサキモータースジャパンは10月22日、998cm 3 スーパーチャージドエンジンを搭載する大型二輪車の新型「Ninja H2 CARBON」を発表した。
2027年1月23日に全国96店舗（2026年10月現在）のカワサキプラザ限定で発売され、価格は418万円。

新型Ninja H2 CARBONは、川崎重工グループの技術を結集して開発された完全自社設計のスーパーチャージャー付き並列4気筒エンジンを搭載するフラグシップモデル。

また、トランスミッションの二次減速比を従来の2.444（44/18）から2.588（44/17）へとショート化し、パイプ径を最適化した新設計の軽量4-into-1エキゾーストシステムと組み合わせることで、スロットル操作に対する加速レスポンスを向上させている。
フロントサスペンションにはモトクロス技術を応用したKYB製「AOS-II」レーシングサスペンション、リアにはオーリンズ製「TTX36」リヤサスペンションを採用し、コーナリング性能と接地感を向上させた。

items.title: Audi reshuffles China leadership amid pressure from local EV brands
items.summary: Former Chery brand CEO Jeff Zhang will take over as president of Audi China on November 1. For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
facts: - Former Chery brand CEO Jeff Zhang will take over as president of Audi China on November 1.
Zhang will take up the post on November 1, according to a statement Audi released on Thursday.
Zhang has more than 20 years of international management experience.
He most recently served as vice president of Chery International and CEO of the Chery brand, and previously ran Chery's (HKEX: 9973) European business.
From 2018 to 2020, Zhang held senior positions at Audi in China, where he was involved in building the sales organization of SAIC Audi and in strategic projects related to FAW Audi.

items.title: Fiat Dresses Up A 15-Year-Old City Car As An Autobianchi For A Good Reason
items.summary: The Fiat Pandina gains a new Tributo Autobianchi flagship with unique trim and high-quality materials inside the cabin, evoking the spirit of the defunct brand
facts: Fiat has introduced a new flagship trim for the aging Pandina, celebrating 30 years since the final Autobianchi rolled off the production line before the Italian brand went down in history.
According to a newly introduced legislation, the Italian government can seize control of classic automotive trademarks that have sat dormant for at least five consecutive years.
The Fiat Pandina is essentially a renamed version of the third-generation Panda, originally introduced in 2011.
Despite being largely unchanged since its debut, the model is the best-selling city car in Europe with 100,000 registrations in the first nine months of 2026.

items.title: Mercedes-AMG Is Developing A New C63, And There Could Be Two Models
items.summary: The next C63 is in the works, with engineers exploring both gasoline and electric versions.
facts: Mercedes-AMG Is Developing A New C63, And There Could Be Two Models
The next C63 is in the works, with engineers exploring both gasoline and electric versions.
The AMG C63 might get a second chance, and this time buyers could choose between gasoline and electric power.
The company's Chief Technology Officer, Jörg Burzer, has hinted that AMG could offer future 63-badged models with both gasoline and electric power.

Pressed on whether that could mean selling a gasoline-powered C63 alongside an electric counterpart, the executive repeated the same answer, suggesting Affalterbach is exploring both possibilities without officially confirming plans for a dual-powertrain C63 lineup.

items.title: Seattle Is Installing Hundreds Of Curbside EV Chargers
items.summary: Residents will decide where the Level 2 chargers will be installed, and the city will prioritize areas with apartment buildings.
facts: Residents will decide where the Level 2 chargers will be installed, and the city will prioritize areas with apartment buildings.
- After the sites are selected, the Level 2 curbside chargers will be installed on a rolling basis from fall 2027 through 2030.
Hundreds of new curbside Level 2 EV chargers will be installed in Seattle, in an effort to make life easier for electric car owners who live in multifamily buildings.
In total, up to 200 new Level 2 EV chargers will be installed across the city by 2030.
Until fall 2027, residents can send in applications for new locations.
According to the city, locations will be chosen in batches of 40-50 at a time, on an ongoing basis.

items.title: Morgan Will Let 50 Customers Design Their Own Sports Cars
items.summary: Bespoke as Standard pairs Morgan Plus Four and Supersport buyers with in-house designers, adding complimentary paint, trim upgrades and crafted personal touches.
facts: Morgan Will Let 50 Customers Design Their Own Sports Cars
Morgan Motor Company is giving 50 customers direct access to its design team under a new program called Bespoke as Standard.
The initiative runs through the end of 2026 and pairs each buyer with Morgan's designers to approve a one-off specification before the car gets built.
The British sports car maker has built cars to order since 1909 at its Pickersleigh Road factory in Malvern, Worcestershire.
2026 Morgan Midsummer Coupe
Morgan revealed an artist's proof prototype on June 24, previewing a strictly limited series of nine customer cars.
Bespoke as Standard now applies that same idea to 50 buyers of Morgan's regular production models.

items.title: Ferrari's Luce EV Costs Way More Than Its V12 Purosangue SUV
items.summary: Maranello’s first EV commands a $122,190 premium over its V12-powered SUV.
facts: Ferrari's Luce EV Costs Way More Than Its V12 Purosangue SUV
Maranello’s first EV commands a $122,190 premium over its V12-powered SUV.
Not necessarily a surprise, but Ferrari's first electric car will cost considerably more than its V12-powered SUV.
Our colleagues at Car and Driver have learned that the Luce starts at $560,800 in the United States, a hefty $122,190 premium over the Purosangue, which starts at $438,610.
Both cars have rear doors and emphasize practicality more than Ferrari's traditional two-seat sports cars, though the electric newcomer takes a different approach with its radically wild styling.

items.title: Xpeng GX deliveries top 30,000 as Middle East orders near 4,000
items.summary: Xpeng says the GX became its fastest model to surpass 10 billion yuan in revenue. For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
facts: - Xpeng says the GX became its fastest model to surpass 10 billion yuan in revenue.
- The flagship SUV reached the milestone about 5 months after launch and accounted for 17.51% of Xpeng's September deliveries.
Cumulative deliveries of Xpeng's (NYSE: XPEV) flagship GX SUV have surpassed 30,000, reaching the milestone about 5 months after launch as the company accelerates its overseas expansion.
The GX set the company's delivery speed record for premium models with an average price of 300,000 yuan ($44,646), Xpeng said.
It also became the company's fastest model to surpass 10 billion yuan in revenue.

items.title: GM Going All-In On AI To Power OnStar And Fast-Track Next-Gen Vehicles
items.summary: GM has committed to using artificial intelligence to accelerate the development of important new models and is adding an AI-powered assistant.
facts: This was thanks to the use of AI that let it test more than 300,000 battery designs in the virtual world before it assembled an actual prototype.
GM is also using the technology in its new OnStar AI Assistant, which will launch with the 2027 Cadillac Lyriq in the coming months through an over-the-air software update.
Perhaps the most interesting element of the system is its ability to explain how certain vehicle functions work.
A new OnStar app is also coming soon, replacing the individual mobile apps already offered by Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, and GMC.

特徴的なヘッドライトや縦型のリアコンビネーションランプ、ボンネットに配された「5」をモチーフにした充電インジケーターなど、随所に遊び心のあるディテールを取り入れている。

フランスで生産されるルノー5には、ルノーが10年以上にわたって培ってきたEV技術が活かされており、EV専用プラットフォームとマルチリンクリアサスペンションの採用により、軽快で安定感のある走りを実現。

facts: If you thought a car like the ND-generation Mazda MX-5 was old, currently in its 11th year of production, you may be surprised to learn about the Hyundai Porter.
This small truck has been around since 1977 and has been sold in its current fourth-generation guise since 2004, with few updates.
Few technical details about the new Porter are known, but it may borrow some components from Kia's larger PV5, which is also available as a back-to-basics commercial truck.
That model uses a modified version of the Hyundai Group's E-GMP platform, known as the E-GMP.S architecture, supporting a 400-volt system.

items.title: Return of the world car: China backs one-size-fits-all approach
items.summary: China's ability to build competitive cars at cheap prices shows that one product for all markets can work Chinese car makers are reviving what many volume brands had written off: the idea of a 'global car' that works across all regions. At the same time, however, premium brands are reluctantly having to admit that their once powerful ability to sell almost exactly the same car everywhere is coming
facts: “All the Chinese OEMs are coming with global cars and we are also going in this direction.” The Renault event marked the introduction of the Geely EX5 electrified SUV into the French company’s plant in Brazil.

The EX5 will be built on the same line as the Renault Boreal, a compact SUV derived from the Dacia Bigster that is being sold in 54 markets globally, including South America, Eastern Europe outside the EU and Turkey.
Now go almost anywhere but the US you will see increasingly familiar Chinese cars such as the EX5, BYD Seal U , Leapmotor C10 and various Chery Tiggos.
Audi, BMW and Porsche are developing larger SUVs to keep pace, while Volvo is developing a new model to sit above the XC90 .
